rationale: The papers 'The stellar and wind parameters of six prototypical HMXBs and their evolutionary status' (2001.02420), 'Dynamics and Equation of State Dependencies of Relevance for Nucleosynthesis in Supernovae and Neutron Star Mergers' (2212.07498), 'Evolution of neutron star magnetic fields' (2109.05584), and 'SCATTER: A New Common Envelope Formalism' (2212.06770) provide insights into the interactions and processes governing the evolution of compact objects and their accretion mechanisms.
